integration: Main agent reviewed all delivered diffs, corrected anchor-first quota clustering and projection tracking, replaced repeated period sorting with one ordered price scan, and fixed the independently reproduced timezone-key membership regression in FORMAT7 with persisted actual timestamp bounds. The read-only worker review preceded FORMAT7; its fix, final semantic comparison, physical process termination and capacity acceptance belong to the main agent. Main integration of the source resolver clears cached intervals at read-frame and write/rollback boundaries and binds each resolver to its own connection. Final source/store tests passed 66/66; the one-million-point candidate completed at the unchanged 224 MiB old-space limit while the saved baseline failed with heap OOM. The full 2,574-test run has 2,547 passes, 25 skips and the two UI failures reproduced on saved pre-B1 code. All workers are closed; no descendants.
